title: ProgRouter: Online Progress-Guided Orchestration for Multi-Agent LLM Workflows under Quality-Cost Tradeoffs
abstract: arXiv:2608.25992v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multi-agent large language model (LLM) workflows have emerged as a powerful paradigm for solving complex, open-ended tasks through collaborative reasoning among specialized LLM agents, but they incur substantial operating costs due to repeated LLM invocations and long-horizon context accumulation. Existing cascade routing methods make one-shot, query-level decisions and cannot adapt to the dynamic, state-dependent nature of multi-step workflows, in which the right LLM at each step depends on evolving task progress, remaining task difficulty, and cost-efficiency requirements. We present ProgRouter, an online progress-guided routing framework that adaptively selects LLM agents across workflow steps to preserve task-solving quality while adhering to time and cost budgets. ProgRouter introduces a multi-view task progress scorer that combines coarse workflow outcome regimes with fine-grained signals on subtask completion, progress trends,

translated_title: ProgRouter：质量-成本权衡下多智能体LLM工作流的在线进度引导编排
translated_abstract: 多智能体大语言模型（LLM）工作流已成为解决复杂、开放式任务的强大范式，它通过多个专业化LLM智能体之间的协作推理来完成任务，但由于反复调用LLM以及长程上下文的累积，会产生巨大的运营成本。现有的级联路由方法只能做出一次性的、查询级别的决策，无法适应多步工作流的动态性和状态依赖性特点——在这种工作流中，每一步应该选用哪个LLM取决于不断演变的任务进度、剩余任务难度以及成本效率要求。我们提出了ProgRouter，这是一个在线的进度引导路由框架，它可以在工作流的各个步骤之间自适应地选择LLM智能体，在保持任务求解质量的同时遵守时间和成本预算。ProgRouter引入了一个多视角任务进度评分器，该评分器将粗粒度的工作流结果状态与子任务完成情况、进度趋势等细粒度信号相结合……
tldr: ProgRouter提出了一个在线进度引导的路由框架，通过多视角任务进度评分器在多步工作流中动态选择LLM智能体，在质量与成本权衡下实现既保证任务质量又符合时间与成本预算的多智能体LLM工作流编排。
en_tdlr: ProgRouter is an online progress-guided routing framework that dynamically selects LLM agents across multi-step workflows using a multi-view task progress scorer, preserving task-solving quality while adhering to time and cost budgets.
